plan.title: feat(release): update the maintainer's local checkout to the new pin after every release

narratives.Description: feat(release): update the maintainer's local checkout to the new pin after every release
narratives.Overview:
- relieves: P1 — Require `--checkout <path>` naming the maintainer primary occupancy root and refuse ambient release-worktree-only success.
- relieves: P2 — Refuse when the target checkout holds a live foreign occupancy lease before any write.
- relieves: P1 — Define `release:local-update` as inline Taskfile `cmds:` without `engine:invoke` or `deps: [ts:build]`, re-resolving the upgrade binary after frozen install.
- relieves: P1 — Require the version-matched agent-hook deposit already merged on tip before upgrade, and keep Phase 7 local closeout incomplete until that deposit evidence exists.
- relieves: P1 — Run `directive upgrade --target-version <version> --yes` against the checkout (never registry-latest resolution).
- relieves: P1 — After upgrade, any tracked-file diff keeps closeout non-zero and incomplete while printing deposit-merge recovery paths for expected managed deposit files.
- relieves: P1 — After upgrade, run `deft verify:hooks-installed --project-root <checkout> --scope=all` from the checkout post-install runtime and re-assert installed runtime equals `<version>`.
- relieves: P2 — Keep ff-only pull, frozen-lockfile install, pin assert, and never reset, force-push, commit, or run global `npm i -g`.
- relieves: P3 — Keep the local-update step required for maintainer non-latest cuts where npm latest will not advance the checkout by accident.
- relieves: P4 — Anchor the Phase 7 step on tip-pin-equals-released observable rather than a phantom existing pin-PR step.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer, after a release pin merges I want my named primary checkout ff-only updated to the released pin with frozen install, version-matched upgrade, and hooks verified fail-closed so commits run the shipped runtime.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Add release:local-update as inline Taskfile cmds (no pin-exclusive engine:invoke), require --checkout primary root, refuse foreign occupancy, require tip deposit evidence, run directive upgrade --target-version, treat any tracked diff as incomplete, verify hooks --project-root --scope=all; edit Phase 7 skill via pack render; unit-test refuse paths.
